description: This file defines functions and registry mechanisms for rendering, unmounting, and updating React components in a testing environment, specifically designed for integration with Playwright. It includes functions like playwrightMount, playwrightUnmount, and playwrightUpdate, and manages component rendering state through a registry.

methods.name: isJsxComponent
methods.description: Type guard function to check if a component object is of type JsxComponent, based on the __pw_type property.

methods.name: __pwRender
methods.description: Converts a component into React elements, handling JSX components and their props, recursively transforming the component for rendering.
